channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Álvaro Dias desiste da disputa ao Senado pelo Paraná após liderar pesquisas
item.description: Álvaro Dias (MDB) announced his withdrawal from the Senate race in Paraná, as stated in a post on his official Instagram profile on Monday afternoon (3). Despite leading in opinion polls, the former senator decided not to run for re-election.

item.title: Augusto Cury descarta chapa com Zema para Presidência: "Não evoluiu"
item.description: Augusto Cury ruled out forming a single ticket with Romeu Zema for the 2026 elections, citing the latter's lack of response after proposing a union. Cury said Zema 'did not evolve' and lamented not receiving a scheduled call, despite calling the idea intelligent for Brazil. He confirmed his presidential pre-candidacy under Avante, with registration due by August 15, and outlined a government plan centered on a national pact with experts to develop Brazil into a first-world nation by 2050.

item.title: PSD oficializa candidatura de Eduardo Braide ao governo do Maranhão
item.description: The PSD officially nominated Eduardo Braide as its candidate for governor of Maranhão, with Elaine Carneiro as vice and André Fufuca (PP) and Lahésio Bonfim (Novo) for the Senate. Braide, re-elected mayor of São Luís in 2024, leads in polls and frames his campaign as opposition to the state’s traditional PT stronghold, rejecting PT alliances and lacking declared support from Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Tereza Cristina diz que "ainda tem espaço" para negociar vice de Flávio
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) stated there is still room to change the PP's neutrality stance and join Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential ticket as vice president, despite the party maintaining its neutral position. She noted that the deadline for party conventions is this Wednesday (August 5) and that, although chances have diminished, there remains space until the final moment for a reversal. Her assessment takes into account the electoral calendar and the August 15 deadline for candidate registration.

item.title: Lancaster MotorSport chega embalada com Daniel Lancaster, André Moraes Jr. e Flávio Abrunhosa para a reta decisiva do Endurance Brasil
item.description: Lancaster MotorSport competes in the Santa Cruz do Sul round of the Endurance Brazil championship with drivers Daniel Lancaster, André Moraes Jr., and Flávio Abrunhosa, following their victory at the Mil Milhas do Brasil. The team retains the same driver lineup for the second consecutive year, aiming for consistency in the season’s final stretch and unveiling a new visual identity for car #22, supported by new sponsors.

item.title: Lobista de Careca do INSS mandou dinheiro para assessor de Lula
item.description: Businesswoman and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger made payments of tens of thousands of reais to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, former Chief of Staff to President Lula, between January 2023 and July 2026. The exact amounts remain undisclosed and are under Federal Police investigation, linking Roberta to the INSS fraud case involving 'Careca do INSS'. The issue caused concern within the PT during Lula’s re-election convention in August 2026, as it risks associating the government with corruption scandals.

item.title: Oppo amplia aposta no Brasil com linha Reno 16 e acessório inédito para selfies. Veja ficha técnica
item.description: Oppo expanded its presence in Brazil with the launch of the Reno 16 smartphone line, featuring two models (Reno 16 and Reno 16 F), and introduced the innovative Oppo Bubble accessory — a magnetic rear-view display for selfies using the rear camera. The company emphasized Brazil as one of its top five global markets, investing in local production, sales channels, and after-sales support.

item.title: MDB oficializa candidatura de Ramuth a vice na chapa de Tarcísio à reeleição em SP
item.description: The São Paulo MDB officially nominated Felício Ramuth as the vice-gubernatorial candidate on the re-election ticket of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for the 2026 elections, following approval in party conventions held in July and August. The party also ratified 86 candidates for state deputy and 69 for federal deputy, with potential to reach 91 and 71 respectively, adhering to the legal limit of seats in contention plus one. Approximately 30% of the slots will be filled by women, as mandated by electoral law.

item.title: Augusto Cury confirma candidatura à Presidência sem anunciar vice
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury confirms his presidential candidacy under the Avante party at a convention in São Paulo, without yet announcing his running mate. He mentions having discussed a potential joint ticket with Romeu Zema, but says the idea likely did not materialize. Cury currently holds 1% in voter intention polls, technically tied with other candidates within the margin of error according to the BTG/Nexus survey.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner cresce 630% em oito anos enquanto senador é investigado no caso Master
item.description: The declared wealth of Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) rose from R$3.3 million in 2018 to R$24 million in 2026, a 630% increase, as he faces investigation by the Federal Police in Operation Compliance Zero over alleged corruption tied to Banco Master. Wagner denies wrongdoing and vows to prove his innocence; the case saw partial lifting of secrecy by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, revealing messages and spreadsheets.

item.title: Projeto da escala 6x1 é ativo político para Lula e preocupa oposição, avaliam parlamentares
item.description: Lawmakers assess that the proposal to abolish the 6x1 work schedule, pushed by labor unions, could serve as a political asset for Lula in his 2026 reelection bid. The measure, aligned with workers’ demands, is expected to strengthen his electoral base and raise concerns among the opposition, which views the issue as a potential vote-splitter.

item.title: TSE receberá do TCU lista de gestores com contas irregulares
item.description: The TSE will receive from the TCU a list of officials with accounts judged irregular over the past eight years, as required by the Clean Record Law. The document will be delivered by TCU President Minister Vital do Rêgo to TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques and will assist the Electoral Justice in evaluating candidacy registrations. Inclusion on the list does not trigger automatic ineligibility, which must be determined case by case by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Tebet defende recursos diretos a municípios e ataca "emendas secretas"
item.description: Simone Tebet, PSB Senate candidate from São Paulo, advocated for direct federal funding to municipalities, criticizing parliamentary amendments as 'secret' and opaque. She stated that the federal government has 200 billion reais in discretionary funds for infrastructure, but Congress controls 260 billion of these funds without transparency, claiming the money 'drips into the pockets of many people'.

item.title: Podemos deve anunciar neutralidade na eleição, apesar de investida de Flávio
item.description: Podemos is expected to declare neutrality in the 2026 presidential election despite pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to secure the party’s support. The decision, to be communicated by party president Renata Abreu by Wednesday, leaves Bolsonaro isolated as other parties like União Brasil-PP and Republicanos also choose neutrality, hindering his alliance-building and TV time prospects.

item.title: Flávio e Lula empatam em 1º turno no RJ, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Prefab Future survey released on August 3, 2026, shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) technically tied in the first round of the 2026 presidential election in Rio de Janeiro, with 31.4% and 31% voting intentions, respectively. The margin of error is 2.19 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, based on 2,000 respondents interviewed between July 24 and 29, 2026. The study, registered with the TSE as RJ-02770/2026, was funded by Diário do Rio de Janeiro and also measured voter rejection rates.

item.title: O salto no número de candidatos do Novo
item.description: The Novo party plans to field approximately 1,250 candidates in the 2026 elections, nearly tripling its 2018 number and representing a 196% increase from its first electoral contest. The party aims to run proportional candidates in almost all states, launch majoritarian candidates—including former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema for president—and targets electing more than ten federal deputies. Party president Eduardo Ribeiro stated this will be the party's 'best generation of candidates,' with growth in both quantity and experience.

item.title: Atual governador, Cidade anuncia manter Corrêa na vice no Amazonas
item.description: Amazonas Governor Roberto Cidade (União Brasil) announced the continuation of Serafim Corrêa (PSB) as his running mate for the 2026 gubernatorial election. The ticket was established following an indirect election in May after the resignation of former Governor Wilson Lima and his vice Tadeu de Souza. The slate will be formally endorsed at the União Progressista federation convention on Tuesday (August 4).

item.title: Ex-ministro e líder do governo, Pimenta declara R$ 130 mil em espécie: ‘Reserva para necessidades eventuais’
item.description: Government leader in the Chamber and former minister Paulo Pimenta (PT-RS) declared R$130,000 in cash in his Senate candidacy, citing it as a reserve for unforeseen needs. His total assets amount to R$1.87 million, including a Brasília property, a Toyota Hilux, stocks, and other holdings. Pimenta has been a federal deputy since 2003 and served in Lula’s administration as Minister of Communication and head of the RS reconstruction effort.

item.title: Sobrinho de Dilma, Pedro Rousseff tem 100% do patrimônio em CDBs
item.description: Pedro Rousseff, nephew of former president Dilma Rousseff, declared R$78,600 in assets, entirely invested in CDBs, while running for federal deputy in Minas Gerais in 2026. He had previously declared no assets in the 2024 municipal elections when elected as a Belo Horizonte city councilman. The PT has fielded 32 candidates for the federal deputy race in MG for 2026.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido do PT para Flávio retirar vídeo em que associa Lula ao PCC
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) rejected an urgent injunction request by the PT-PCdoB-PV federation to remove a video by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) that associates President Lula with the PCC. The video, posted on social media, criticizes the federal government's public security policy. The ruling keeps the content online, stating there is insufficient evidence to constitute abuse of power or electoral defamation.

item.title: Toffoli rejeita queixa-crime contra Erika Hilton no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli dismissed a criminal complaint against federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSol-SP), ruling that the NGO lacked standing to file a private criminal action, the petition failed to meet procedural requirements, and the alleged statements were made in the course of her parliamentary duties without manifestly exceeding the limits of political criticism.

item.title: Podemos deve anunciar neutralidade na eleição e inviabilizar Renata Abreu vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Podemos is expected to announce neutrality in the 2026 presidential election following consultations with its state directories, which prevents Renata Abreu, the party's national president, from becoming Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate. The move aims to preserve the party's electoral strength in Lula-supporting states and avoid adopting Flávio's ideological agenda nationally, as Podemos prioritizes growing its congressional caucus.

item.title: Luciano Bivar, que deu partido a Bolsonaro em 2018, agora é PT
item.description: Luciano Bivar, former PSL president who backed Jair Bolsonaro in 2018, has been confirmed as the first substitute on Senator Humberto Costa's (PT-PE) re-election ticket for 2026, during the Brasil da Esperança Federation convention in Pernambuco. His shift to the PT marks a significant political reversal, given his public falling-out with Bolsonaro after the 2018 election, including Bolsonaro's accusation that Bivar was 'queimado para caramba' in Pernambuco and federal investigations into party fund misuse. Bivar was filmed singing a pro-Lula chant alongside Costa, symbolizing his new alliance with the Workers' Party.

item.title: O novo marqueteiro de Flávio Bolsonaro ainda está entrando em campo
item.description: Duda Lima was announced as the new campaign strategist for Flávio Bolsonaro, but has not yet fully entered the field. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Lulinha pede à PF e ao governo apuração sobre vazamento de dados sigilosos
item.description: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha and son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has requested an investigation by the Federal Police's Internal Affairs Office and the Ministry of Justice regarding the leak of confidential data obtained through a judicial breach of secrecy in an inquiry into improper discounts in INSS pensions and retirements. He claims the leak was unlawful and demands accountability for those responsible.

item.title: Centrão teria vários motivos para não se unir a Flávio, mas ‘recomendação’ do STF seria abismante
item.description: The Centrão avoids aligning with Flávio Bolsonaro not due to fear of the STF, but because of concrete reasons such as corruption investigations, organized crime links, and suspicious financing. The narrative of STF 'pressure' on parties to refrain from supporting him is seen as authoritarian and inappropriate, as it conflicts with judicial independence. The Supreme Court should not influence electoral choices, even if it has the power to investigate the candidate.

item.title: PF pede 3º inquérito contra Lulinha por tráfico de influência
item.description: The Federal Police requested the STF to open a third investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) for alleged influence peddling on behalf of 3Structure IT Ltda., a company with R$ 81 million in federal contracts. The defense claims there is no solid evidence and accuses the PF of using 'fishing expeditions' to sway the 2026 elections, while President Lula stated his son will face no special treatment.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Renan Santos, Lula e Michelle Bolsonaro lançam candidaturas
item.description: Renan Santos, Lula, and Michelle Bolsonaro officially launched their candidacies during this weekend's party conventions, kicking off the 2026 electoral race. The Papo Antagonista analyzed the political implications of these announcements, emphasizing the growing polarization among Brazil's major political forces.

item.title: A agenda dos empresários coincide com o que Lula e Flávio dizem?
item.description: The National Confederation of Industry (CNI) launched 'Building Brazil 2050', a 300-page document proposing a national strategy based on macroeconomic stability, productivity, and competitiveness to guide its institutional actions in the 2026 elections. While the text does not explicitly mention Lula or Flávio, it reflects priorities often associated with both: fiscal stability and industrial growth focus. This suggests potential convergence between the business agenda and the proposals of the two leaders, despite political differences.

item.title: ‘Flávio não entende do assunto’, afirma Caiado ao disputar eleitorado do agronegócio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, attacked Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for allegedly lacking understanding of agribusiness, asserting that his own decades-long trajectory in the sector gives him authority to defend it. Caiado highlighted his record in Goiás and Mato Grosso, praised the development of Matopiba, and criticized PT governments for weakening institutions like Embrapa. He also stated that his rural electorate has not yet mobilized and that avoiding a runoff with Flávio Bolsonaro is crucial to preventing a Lula victory.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: projeção da pesquisa BTG/Nexus mostra como fica o 2º turno após migração de votos
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 45% in a potential runoff, but a projection based on vote migration from eliminated candidates shows a technical tie at 43.9% each. Lula’s advantage in the official poll comes from undecided, blank, or null voters whose redistribution is not disclosed. Flávio Bolsonaro gains the most from third-way voters, particularly from supporters of Caiado, Zema, and Renan Santos.

item.title: Alvaro Dias anuncia que não será candidato ao Senado
item.description: Former senator Alvaro Dias (MDB) announced via an open letter that he will not run for a Senate seat in the 2026 elections. The politician opted not to seek re-election, ending his tenure in the Federal Senate after three terms.

item.title: Tereza Cristina diz que negociação para vice de Flávio ‘ainda tem espaço’
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) reiterated that there is still room for her to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) vice-presidential candidate in the 2026 election, despite the PP's veto and the federation with União Brasil. She had initially accepted the offer, but the party declared neutrality, blocking the ticket. Bolsonaro said he respects the decision but will not give up.

item.title: Crusoé: Renato Bolsonaro declara patrimônio R$ 2,9 milhões menor ao TSE
item.description: Renato Bolsonaro, federal deputy candidate for PL-SP and brother of former President Jair Bolsonaro, told the TSE his wealth decreased by R$ 2.9 million over two years, now totaling R$ 268 thousand, mostly in financial applications. The disclosure includes a Banco do Brasil CDB but does not detail other holdings. The decline was attributed to asset devaluation, without specifying causes.

item.title: Caiado nega estar "batendo" em Flávio: "Não está sabendo se explicar"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) denied attacking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), stating that the senator is merely being held accountable for allegations against him, particularly regarding the R$ 61 million transfer from Banco Master to the film 'Dark Horse'. Caiado also criticized Flávio for questioning electronic voting machines, emphasizing his own democratic record of accepting electoral losses.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner, que liderou o governo Lula no Senado, cresce 631% em oito anos
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) saw his wealth increase by 631% over eight years, rising from R$ 3.3 million in 2018 to R$ 24.5 million in 2026. The growth stems largely from the sale of land to Bahia’s SAF and Lagoons Empreendimentos for R$ 13.8 million, plus the sale of a Salvador apartment for R$ 10 million. Undeclared assets seized by the Federal Police, including US$ 65,795 and 39,000 euros, were not reported in his official TSE filing.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido da Federação PT-PCdoB-PV para retirar vídeo em que Flávio associa Lula ao crime organizado
item.description: The TSE rejected the PT-PCdoB-PV Federation's request to remove a video by Flávio Bolsonaro linking Lula to organized crime, ruling that the claims were not proven false and fall within protected political speech. Minister Nunes Marques stated that electoral justice should not replace political debate and that content removal requires manifest illegality. The video remains online as it was made during pre-campaign without an explicit call to vote.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner cresce R$ 21,2 milhões em 8 anos
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner’s (PT-BA) assets grew by R$ 21.2 million between 2018 and 2026, rising from R$ 3.4 million to R$ 24.5 million — a 631% increase over eight years. He disclosed the figures to electoral authorities, and the data was published by the TSE in August 2026. Wagner is running for re-election in Bahia at an event with Lula, while under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged favoritism toward Banco Master.

item.title: “Minha candidatura é igual à música sertaneja”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) compared his presidential pre-candidacy to sertanejo music, saying that just as the genre faced initial prejudice before becoming widely popular, his campaign also began with resistance but is now gaining acceptance. He made the remark on Tuesday, the 3rd, in an interview published by O Antagonista.

item.title: ‘Novela Cleitinho’ termina sem ‘reviravolta da reviravolta’ e com o senador fora da disputa por MG
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo abandoned his bid for the Minas Gerais governorship in 2026 after the national directory of the Republicans party vetoed his candidacy, citing lost trust due to delayed decision-making and absence from the state convention. His withdrawal ends a prolonged political saga that demobilized the state's center-right, delaying a strong slate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and aiding the PT, which is advancing Patrus Ananias for governor and Lulu for re-election in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Patrimônio de Jaques Wagner cresceu R$ 21 milhões em 8 anos. Veja os bens
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner's (PT-BA) assets grew by R$ 21.1 million between 2018 and 2026, rising from R$ 3.3 million to R$ 24.5 million, according to his TSE declaration. The increase is mainly due to credit from the sale of a property to Esporte Clube Bahia and Lagoons Empreendimentos SPE LTDA (R$ 13.8 million) and financial investments in BB funds and bonds. He declared six vehicles, an apartment in Salvador, and half a rural property in Andaraí (BA).

item.title: Após racha entre candidato de Zema e Aro por vaga na chapa em MG, PSD lança Carlos Viana ao Senado
item.description: The PSD officially nominated Carlos Viana for Senate re-election in Minas Gerais following a split with Marcelo Aro (PP), who had been expected to occupy the Senate spot on Governor Mateus Simões’ ticket. Aro, dissatisfied with Viana’s inclusion, was likened to Eduardo Cunha by Simões and is now being considered for a gubernatorial run or a spot on Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential ticket.

item.title: Republicanos avisa ao PL que 17 diretórios estaduais querem independência na corrida presidencial
item.description: Republicans informed the PL that 17 of its state directories support independence in the 2026 presidential election, while only nine favor an alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro. The party prioritizes electing federal deputies and senators to strengthen its congressional presence, while the PL seeks to secure Daniella Marques as Flávio’s running mate despite the senator being in a technical tie with Lula in polls. The PP has declared neutrality, limiting vice-presidential options for the Bolsonaro ticket.

item.title: Bastidores: Pereira avisa ao PL que 18 diretórios do Republicanos não querem aliança com Flávio
item.description: Republicans informed the PL that most of its state directories (17 out of 27) chose neutrality in the 2026 presidential election, with only nine favoring an alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro and one (Pernambuco) supporting Lula. The party prioritizes electing federal deputies and senators to strengthen its congressional presence, citing grievances with the Bolsonaros and aversion to alliances in a radicalized election. The PL is still trying to keep Daniella Marques as Flávio’s running mate, while the PP announced neutrality, limiting options for the Bolsonaro ticket.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE desmonta urna eletrônica nesta 2ª feira
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) conducted a live disassembly of an electronic voting machine on Monday, August 3, 2026, at 5:30 PM, during the opening of the 1st National Week of the Electronic Voting System in Brasília. Led by Electoral Technology Coordinator Rafael Azevedo, the demonstration exposed key security components, including the motherboard, storage media for official voting software, and the encrypted vote recording module, aiming to enhance transparency and counter misinformation about Brazil’s electoral system.

item.title: TSE realiza sessão de abertura do segundo semestre forense na próxima segunda (3)
item.description: The TSE will hold the opening session of the second forensic semester of 2026 on Monday, the 3rd, at 7 p.m., broadcast live via Radio and TV Justice and the Tribunal’s YouTube channel. During the session, TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques will officially launch the National Week of the Electronic Voting System, aiming to inform the public about the security, transparency, and auditability of electronic voting machines, with the General Elections just 62 days away. The Tribunal will also review three-name lists for judicial vacancies in TRE-ES and TRE-PA, and two cases involving fines for illegal donations and electoral propaganda on common-use property, both reported by Minister Dias Toffoli.

item.title: Reunião com Republicanos para indicar vice foi mais um banho de água fria na campanha de Flávio Boslonaro
item.description: The meeting between Republicanos party leader Marcos Pereira, Flávio Bolsonaro, his campaign coordinator Rogério Marinho, and PL president Valdemar Costa Neto failed to yield the expected results, particularly regarding a vice-presidential nomination. Described as a 'cold shower,' the encounter reflected a lack of anticipated support or agreement. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro ficará três dias sem agendas públicas nesta semana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro will suspend public engagements until Wednesday to meet with Centrão parties and seek coalitions that could increase his propaganda time and secure a female-appealing running mate. His campaign will use the BTG/Nexus poll showing Lula’s lead narrowed to just four points (41% to 37%) to persuade centrist parties to back him in the first round, promising them privileged positions in a potential PL government.

item.title: Podemos resiste à indicação de sua presidente como vice de Flávio
item.description: National president of Podemos, federal deputy Renata Abreu (SP), is consulting state directories on whether to support her candidacy as vice-president on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) ticket. The suggestion came from São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB), and the party has not yet officially decided its position in the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende condenação de ex-senador e permite candidatura
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Nunes Marques suspended the conviction of former senator Acir Gurgacz (PDT), allowing him to run in the 2026 elections, arguing the case should not have been reviewed by the STF as it was unrelated to his mandate. The decision follows the PGR’s opinion and was made due to the deadline for party conventions, despite Gurgacz having already served his sentence and the Clean Record Law normally barring him. This is his sixth criminal revision request, with four previously rejected and one pending appeal.
